# WeChat Official Account HTML Guide

Canonical URL: https://v0idream.github.io/wechat-official-account-html-guide/
Repository: https://github.com/V0idream/wechat-official-account-html-guide

## Purpose

A field-tested guide for reliably pasting custom or AI-generated HTML into WeChat Official Account articles.

## Primary problem statements

- ChatGPT / AI generated WeChat Official Account HTML loses images after paste.
- Base64 images disappear in the WeChat editor.
- Images using WeChat CDN appear but lose intended width or position.
- CSS `<style>` blocks, classes, or pseudo-elements are stripped.
- Xiumi HTML imports may preserve text/layout but lose images.

## Core solution

1. Upload final images to WeChat and use `mmbiz.qpic.cn` URLs.
2. Inline all critical CSS into each HTML element.
3. Control image width through both the outer container and the `<img>` itself.
4. Use `!important` for critical image width/max-width/height rules where needed.
5. Replace essential pseudo-elements with real HTML nodes.

## Main document

README.md contains the full Chinese guide.
README_EN.md contains an English summary.

This file is an additional machine-readable summary; the README and rendered GitHub Pages article remain the authoritative documentation.
